# LakeForge: explore gold + quarantine

Run `lakeforge run --start 2024-01 --end 2024-01` first. Set `LAKE_ROOT` if you changed it.

import os
from pathlib import Path

import duckdb
from deltalake import DeltaTable

LAKE_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("LAKE_ROOT", "./data/lake")).resolve()


def ds(layer, name):
    return DeltaTable((LAKE_ROOT / layer / name).as_posix()).to_pyarrow_dataset()


con = duckdb.connect()
con.register("daily_summary", ds("gold", "daily_summary"))
con.register("fact_trips_daily", ds("gold", "fact_trips_daily"))
con.register("dim_zone", ds("gold", "dim_zone"))
con.register("quarantine_trips", ds("quarantine", "taxi_trips"))

daily = con.sql("SELECT * FROM daily_summary ORDER BY pickup_date").df()
daily["revenue"] = daily["revenue"].astype(float)
daily.plot(x="pickup_date", y="trips", figsize=(10, 3), title="Trips per day")
daily.plot.scatter(x="precip_mm", y="revenue", figsize=(6, 4), title="Revenue vs precipitation")

con.sql(
    """
    SELECT z.borough, z.zone, sum(f.trips) AS trips
    FROM fact_trips_daily f JOIN dim_zone z ON f.pu_location_id = z.zone_key
    GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 15
    """
).df()

con.sql(
    """
    SELECT rule, count(*) AS rows_failed
    FROM (SELECT unnest(_failed_rules) AS rule FROM quarantine_trips)
    GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY rows_failed DESC
    """
).df()
